Search, Count, Min/Max

One loop skeleton, three memories. Crown, click, locate.

⏱ 20 min🧠 No experience needed🧪 Interactive
Step 1

Tallest student, one pass

Crown first, dethrone taller.

🏆

Trophy walk. Crown student one, walk the line, swap on taller. Counting = clicker per match. Searching = stop at first call + sentinel −1 for absent.

ProgramRead each line in order
public class Main {
  public static void main(String[] args) {
    int[] a = {4, 9, 2, 9};
    int max = a[0];   // crown the first contender
    int count9 = 0;   // clicker for nines
    int pos2 = -1;    // sentinel: not found yet
    for (int i = 0; i < a.length; i++) {
      if (a[i] > max) max = a[i];
      if (a[i] == 9) count9++;
      if (a[i] == 2) pos2 = i;
    }
    System.out.println("max = " + max);
    System.out.println("nines = " + count9);
    System.out.println("first 2 at = " + pos2);
  }
}

One walk, three answers. 4 crowns, 9 dethrones.
